sources.description: Sean McVay does not foresee wide receiver Puka Nacuaor offensive tackle Alaric Jackson being unavailable for the Los Angeles Rams' Week 1 game against the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.

sources.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is reportedly expected to play in the team's Week 1 opener against the San Francisco 49ers on Thursday night, head coach Sean McVay announced.

sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua and left tackle Alaric Jackson are both on the team's active roster on Monday and the team isn't expecting that to change ahead of their opener against the 49ers.
